work.author: Clemens. PP. XIII.
work.description: Entire genuine CXVIII mission letter through 60146 plus 20 LF context read. Complete addressee, protocol, salutation, continuous substantive letter and dated closing are clean. Exact disjoint selection excludes the following royal letter’s displaced marginal notes 60109–60125; own separate marginal dating 60105–60106 remains literal. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
